subject: english
question:
Directions: Each item in this section has a sentence with three underlined parts labelled as (a), (b) and (c). Read each sentence to find out whether there is any error in any underlined part and indicate your response on the answer sheet against the corresponding letter, i.e., (a) or (b) or (c). If you find no error, your response should be indicated as (d).

 

__My friends are gone__ (a)/ __on a trip to__ (b)/ __Goa today__ (c)/ __No error__(d).
solution:
The erroneous segment is "**My friends** **are gone**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the verb form "**gone**" is incorrect in the erroneous segment.
 
• The given sentence is in the **present tense**.
 
• So we can't use the past participle of the verb 'go' which is "**gone**".
 
• We need to use the **gerund **form of the verb "go" which is "**going**" in the sentence.

**The correct sentence is: ***My friends are **going **__on a trip to Goa today.*

Hence, the correct answer is **option 3**.
